knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Poor beading and pooling mean the protection is wearing.
A supportable statement names the maker's figure and its conditions.
Routine shampoo keeps the protection; degreasers strip it when used too often.

practicalCriteria: Sets an interval for each of three protected surfaces, each tied to a named product.
Demonstrates the water-beading check on a sample panel and explains the signs of wear to a simulated owner.
Writes an aftercare note with no durability claim beyond the maker's figure.
passRule: Three intervals recorded, beading check demonstrated, and aftercare note free of unsupported claims. Observed by an assessor. A quiz pass is not a practical pass.
stopWorkCriteria: Lifetime or unsupported durability claim made
Degreaser recommended for routine washing without re-protection advice
